description: Type the 400 PATCH /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/state answers to the `awake` command for a service that is not idle: {"status": 400, "error": "BAD_REQUEST: Service must be in idle state to awake"}. The spec types it only as the shared envelope, so it surfaced as the generic BadRequest, which every invalid request body also answers. Observed live 2026-11-12 sending command awake to a running service (request id 763c5551-1f2b-453d-9abb-6f463ca7cf2c) and to a stopped one (request id b869c8f7-1ffb-490a-ae52-c2ec61d6d639). The start and stop commands are idempotent (200 in every state).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The service is not idle, so it cannot be awakened. Read its state and send start or stop instead.

message.includes: Service must be in idle state to awake
